name: Battery
purpose: The power module provides a stable working voltage of 28.5V to each module and maintains it during operation
ports: The input of the power module is the startup signal evstart (bool type), and the output is the voltage signal (real type) supplied to the power-consuming modules
states: There are two states: initial state and working state. After receiving the evStart signal in the initial state, it enters the working state and maintains the working state while sending a working voltage of 28.5V
